metadata.name: contested_fork_threshold
metadata.description: Reorg pain threshold sweep: maps (vr, C, E) -> fork depth and duration. 120 scenarios: 3 vr x 4 E x 5 C x 2 compositions. New metrics: reorg_depth, fork_balance, pain_score. E=0.30-0.55 extends into unexplored low-E territory. composition_seed decouples pool identity from aggregate C.
